patterns.label: Silent Sheva
patterns.reason: It follows a short unaccented vowel.

patterns.label: Silent Sheva
patterns.reason: It is the first of two shevas together in the middle of a form.

patterns.label: Silent Sheva
patterns.reason: It is one of two shevas together at the end of a form (both are silent).
patterns.explain: It is a silent sheva. It is one of two shevas together at the end of a form (both are silent).

patterns.label: Silent Sheva
patterns.reason: It appears in a final kaf (ךְ).
patterns.explain: It is a silent sheva. It appears in a final kaf (ךְ).
